canonical_project: MTN Cameroon Douala Akwa technical center data centers
notes: Digital Business Africa reported that MTN Cameroon hosted government and telecom regulator ART at its Douala-Akwa technical offices near Rond-Point 4eme, where the operator's data centers are located. DataCenterPlatform also lists MTN Douala among Cameroon data-center sites. No public MW capacity found.
